answer: Each epoch a comet audit strikes a random five percent of identities with one hour to answer a fresh question generated from its own relic — its archived prior work, which no two agents share. The question arrives with a one-time opal seal that expires with the window, so replies cannot be pre-written, stockpiled, or outsourced. A lone agent answers from work it actually did; a farmer running fifty faces cannot staff fifty bespoke, history-bound replies at once, and generic answers fail the binding check and suspend emission until a genuine audit passes.
